I will try to help you figure out the amount of [team name] in the world.  All numbers are from [this Wikipedia entry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Potato).

The closest I could get to figuring out the number of potatoes in the world was the statistic that says that in 2014, 382 million tonnes were produced worldwide.  Now I'm assuming these are metric tons and not freedom tons.  

There are 1,000,000 grams in a metric ton and according to [this](https://cooking.stackexchange.com/questions/10413/how-much-does-a-large-potato-weigh) an average potato weighs about 225 grams.  Dividing 1,000,000 by 225 gives us 4444.4 repeating, which I'll round up to 4445 for convenience sake.

The Wikipedia entry has two numbers for the number of potato species in the world, 4000 and 5000.  Let's pick a nice easy number between this, say 4445.  So there are 4445 species of potatoes in the world.

Assuming the species are evenly distributed among a ton of potatoes, that means there is one of each variety of potato in a metric ton of potatoes.  So we get one [potato variety] potato per metric ton.

Multiplying the 382 million tons of potatoes x the 1 [potato variety] potato in each ton, of course gives us that there 328 million [potato variety] potatoes in the world.  So there are many more [potato variety]s (potatoes) than [team name] fans in the world.
